notes.title: New in Hotel Tales: Mix Drinks & Serve Dishes! 💋
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/5e3707ab06e408a3083d50cd2b09774880e11ab2.png[/img]
[h3][b]🔮 Long time no see, traveler
[/b][/h3]
A lot has happened at Hotel Tales while you were away 👀 We haven't been idle - we've added new mini-games, improved the old ones and now every corner of our mysterious place is even more tempting. Take a seat next to the Mistress - now we'll tell you what's new🍷😉

❤️ But before that - don't forget to add Hotel Tales to your Steam wishlist! Want to be the first to join the company of our seductive female staff? Then don't delay 💋😏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales
[b]🍹"Mix Cocktails" mini-game
[/b]
Become the bartender of your dreams and surprise your guests! Who knows, maybe you'll even outshine Lavo herself with your magical drinks? 😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/91ee38e3a80241c26fd9b890eaf85be6fa4ba94c.png[/img]
[b]🧩 Piece by piece
[/b]
The paintings in the hotel are all mixed up - and only you can put them back in shape. Assemble each puzzle to immerse yourself in the past and uncover unexpected plot details 🖼️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/e97f843b0b18c522d158370053c2254d5b846528.png[/img]
[b]🍽 Cooking Upgrade: now with magic and serving!
[/b]
Not just cooking, but also serving dishes! Choose products from the shelves, follow the recipe and watch the real gastronomic magic happen 😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/cf65f3770de16eac4f1564d245e3112eb9e0f02f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/2ac86e831a1a0f99c500cc7b8456e2030d70ca26.png[/img]
[b]🧳"Stack the Luggage" mini-game
[/b]
Try yourself as an attentive doorman - pack your suitcases neatly and quickly. Who knows what kind of thanks your guest will leave in return? 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/6a71e866f059030c28a8711b8d91d74e5bf59d41.png[/img]

[i]Which mini-game was your favorite? What would you like to see at the hotel in the future? Write in the comments - we read everything! And, as always, we're around and always on reception duty with Parsithea 🛎️💕[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/299bb1ac570f28aab18a20c1c994d785d18132cb.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales

notes.title: Hotel Tales: Life after First Demo
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45497050/b086effc893034f14ce21f9cc61c306f61502012.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧜‍♀️ Hey, newbie! I don't think we've met? That's okay, let’s introduce ourselves! 🧜‍♀️[/b][/h3]

My name is Parsithea - I'm the hostess at the Crossroads Hotel and its charming face. [i]But first and foremost, of course, a hostess! [/i]Today I'm going to tell you about what has changed at our hotel since your last visit. Get ready, it's about to get interesting! 💋

[h3]You can join the hotel staff HERE 👇 👇[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45497050/456f03211266b1fd64b7128a2ad03ba5b197a686.png[/img]

Hotel Tales’ development doesn't stop for a second: new mini-games, backgrounds and characters are in the works, and the Hotel universe is growing fresh lore every day. But that's not all - another demo is in the active stage of development, where a new heroine - [b]Parsithea[/b] - is waiting for you, as well as some cool art! 🔥🔥🔥

[b]A little bit of information about the new heroine: [/b]

Once upon a time, Parsithea fell in love with a handsome prince and decided to trade her tail for a pair of shapely legs to please him. The romance lasted a week and after that the prince married the princess, leaving Parsithea alone. The spell that gave her legs begins to wear off over time, so Parsithea looks more and more like a mermaid every day. However, the more she resembles a mermaid, the better she sings.

[h3][b]Add Hotel Tales to your wishlist and all your dreams will come true! 😍[/b][/h3]
